entities.summary: Louis Bielle-Biarrey is a French professional rugby union wing who currently plays for Bordeaux Bègles in the Top 14 and France national team. He is Bordeaux's top try scorer after scoring his 47th try in the 2025–26 Top 14 season games against Lyon OU.
